I'm **Tinevimbo**, a TPU builder based in Zimbabwe. This blog is the public lab
notebook for *Batched LLM Steering on TPU*, my project for the TorchTPU Sprint 26H4.

## The project in one paragraph

Activation steering edits a model's residual stream at inference time: add a
concept direction to make the model more of something, project it out to make
it less. Each setting (direction, layer, strength) is one experiment, and good
settings sit in a narrow window. Instead of running settings one at a time, I
give every row of a batch its own setting, so one forward pass on a TPU covers
hundreds of experiments.
